purpose: Directly test whether initial I-locus allele accessibility and carrier allocation alter the six-class temporal response order of assurance A and floral investment I in native finite Model 3.
inference_boundary: Synthetic independent founder and visitor streams, not islands; intervention changes I allele support, variance and carrier distribution; no Q3 density/ABM mediation, Q4 survival rescue or source-selection effect identified.

visitors.relation: independent synthetic visitor seeds, held common across genotype policies

response.extinct_trajectories: Keep in denominator; report separate extinction status, never call extinction a completed trait event

randomization.streams: native independent survival/parents/segregation/mutation/recruitment streams; all are paired across genotype policies for founder, visitor, environment

primary_estimands.name: carrier_order_score_delta
primary_estimands.description: (P(A-first)-P(I-first)) dense_reachable minus sparse_reachable within far, all starts

primary_estimands.name: carrier_I_event_delta
primary_estimands.description: P(I event) dense_reachable minus sparse_reachable in far, all starts

structural_controls: All three policies have exactly the same expressed X/I/A vector per founder at t0 and identical native reproductive ledger in each mating/environment context.
The narrow dense_unreachable policy has minimum inherited I allele 0.453125 > 0.45 and no I mutation or immigration, so an I decrease >=0.05 is structurally unreachable.
dense and sparse policies have the same I allele support set, with different numbers of low-I carriers; zero-mutation I is enforced at every update.
secondary_estimands: All six class probabilities, no excluded outcomes
Dense-reachable minus dense-unreachable I-event and order contrasts, with structural interpretation
Near-arm replication, descriptive, not used to replace far results
Allele-support loss incidence over trajectories and time, descriptive without selection/drift causal decomposition

inference.units: 8 founder labels crossed with 8 visitor-history labels, NOT 64 independent islands; same labels resampled across interventions
inference.simultaneous_method: Bonferroni two-sided 97.5% percentile intervals for two co-primary contrasts, independent two-way resampling of founders and visitors
inference.decision: BOTH co-primary contrasts exclude zero to confirm a coupled order+event change; otherwise partial, inconclusive, or null-directional findings reported unchanged

required_for_full_execution: Original Model 3 source file SHA-256 manifest and matching frozen study design
Fail-closed original source and full 384-case task inventory
Human-reviewed synthetic founder intervention and unchanged t0 ledgers
Full 201-point census, complete typed diploid genomes and parentage saved for every full case
Independent re-admission of source/full cases, yearwise events and bootstrap summaries
Explicit owner approval and protected activation before long production; no unreviewed PR push biology
status_policy: No permission to label technical smoke as research evidence; no large production launch from PR CI
